item.title: reproducible builds in practice
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: reproducible builds is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Reproducible builds shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: notes on reproducible builds
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to reproducible builds, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Reproducible builds shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
